tool_input.command:
cd <repo>
git add internal/hook/format_output.go internal/hook/format_output_test.go
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(hook): formatMissionAbandon no longer prints an empty Disclaimed line or silently drops a malformed entry (PR #509 tail #6, F3)

A non-string entry in the abandon payload's disclaimed array was
silently skipped by the ids-append loop with no signal it happened, and
when EVERY entry was malformed the code still printed a bare
"Disclaimed: " line with nothing after the colon. Matches
writeMissionWarnings's own established convention: skip the malformed
entry from the rendered line but report it loudly on stderr naming the
cause, and only emit the Disclaimed: line when at least one entry
actually decoded.

Confirmed both failure modes red against the pre-fix code before
landing the fix.
EOF
)"
